title: bug: error starting a podman machine on macbook neo
body:
### Issue Description

When trying to create and start a podman machine on macbook Neo, I get a Segfault error


### Steps to reproduce the issue

```
 % podman machine init --provider libkrun
Looking up Podman Machine image at quay.io/podman/machine-os:6.0 to create VM
Extracting compressed file: podman-machine-default-arm64.raw: done  
Machine init complete
To start your machine run:

	podman machine start

philippe@macbook-de-philippe1 ~ % podman machine start                  
Starting machine "podman-machine-default"
Error: krunkit was terminated by signal: segmentation fault
```


### Describe the results you received

the podman machine should start, or indicate an error indicating that the platform is not supported

### Describe the results you expected

segmentation fault

### podman info output

```yaml
% podman version      
Client:        Podman Engine
Version:       6.0.2
API Version:   6.0.2
Go Version:    go1.26.5
Git Commit:    b28edb9ad70ce4317dc762ee9ce0a6d081d154e9
Built:         Wed Jul 22 04:55:39 2026
Build Origin:  pkginstaller
OS/Arch:       darwin/arm64
```

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

None

### Upstream Latest Release

Yes

### Additional environment details

Apple A18 Pro
8Gb
26.5.2 (25F84


### Additional information

Additional information like issue happens only occasionally or issue happens with a particular architecture or on a particular setting
